%% cvforge-template v1
%% sections: experience, education, skills
%% supports: person.phone, person.links, experience.location, skills.groups
%% max-bullets-per-role: 5
%% engine: lualatex
%
% Awesome-CV resume.tex (LPPL 1.3c, Byungjin Park), converted to the cvforge contract. Class,
% fonts (Source Sans 3, Roboto, Font Awesome 6), colours and layout are the original's.
% Sections without profile data (summary, honors, certificates) are removed; skills use the
% class's own cvskills environment. Needs tests/fixtures/templates/provision.sh for its fonts.
%!TEX TS-program = lualatex
%!TEX encoding = UTF-8 Unicode
% Awesome CV LaTeX Template for CV/Resume
%
% This template has been downloaded from:
% https://github.com/posquit0/Awesome-CV
%
% Author:
% Claud D. Park <posquit0.bj@gmail.com>
% http://www.posquit0.com
%
% Template license:
% CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
%


%-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% CONFIGURATIONS
% Build from the repository root with: latexmk examples/resume.tex
%-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% A4 paper size by default, use 'letterpaper' for US letter
\documentclass[11pt, a4paper]{awesome-cv}

% Configure page margins with geometry
\geometry{left=1.4cm, top=.8cm, right=1.4cm, bottom=1.8cm, footskip=.5cm}

% Color for highlights
% Awesome Colors: awesome-emerald, awesome-skyblue, awesome-red, awesome-pink, awesome-orange
%                 awesome-nephritis, awesome-concrete, awesome-darknight
\colorlet{awesome}{awesome-red}
% Uncomment if you would like to specify your own color
% \definecolor{awesome}{HTML}{3E6D9C}

% Colors for text
% Uncomment if you would like to specify your own color
% \definecolor{darktext}{HTML}{414141}
% \definecolor{text}{HTML}{333333}
% \definecolor{graytext}{HTML}{5D5D5D}
% \definecolor{lighttext}{HTML}{999999}
% \definecolor{sectiondivider}{HTML}{5D5D5D}

% Set false if you don't want to highlight section with awesome color
\setbool{acvSectionColorHighlight}{true}

% If you would like to change the social information separator from a pipe (|) to something else
\renewcommand{\acvHeaderSocialSep}{\quad\textbar\quad}


%-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
%	PERSONAL INFORMATION
%	Comment any of the lines below if they are not required
%-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Available options: circle|rectangle,edge/noedge,left/right
%-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
%	PERSONAL INFORMATION (cvforge: filled from the profile)
%-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
\name{\VAR{person.name}}{}
\position{\VAR{person.title_line}}
\BLOCK{if person.location}
\address{\VAR{person.location}}
\BLOCK{endif}
\BLOCK{if person.phone}
\mobile{\VAR{person.phone}}
\BLOCK{endif}
\email{\VAR{person.email}}
\BLOCK{for link in person.links}
\BLOCK{if 'github.com/' in link.text}
\github{\VAR{link.text.split('/')[-1]}}
\BLOCK{elif 'linkedin.com/in/' in link.text}
\linkedin{\VAR{link.text.split('/')[-1]}}
\BLOCK{else}
\homepage{\VAR{link.text}}
\BLOCK{endif}
\BLOCK{endfor}
%% cvforge: the sample \quote is removed; the profile has no quote.

\begin{document}

\makecvheader[C]

\makecvfooter
  {\today}
  {\VAR{person.name}~~~·~~~Résumé}
  {\thepage}

%-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
%	EXPERIENCE (as in examples/resume/experience.tex)
%-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
\cvsection{Work Experience}

\begin{cventries}
\BLOCK{for job in experience}

  \cventry
    {\VAR{job.title}} % Job title
    {\VAR{job.org}} % Organization
    {\VAR{job.location}} % Location
    {\VAR{job.start} - \VAR{job.end}} % Date(s)
    {
\BLOCK{if job.bullets}
      \begin{cvitems} % Description(s) of tasks/responsibilities
\BLOCK{for b in job.bullets}
        \item {\VAR{b.text}} % id:\VAR{b.id}
\BLOCK{endfor}
      \end{cvitems}
\BLOCK{endif}
    }
\BLOCK{endfor}

\end{cventries}

%-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
%	EDUCATION (as in examples/resume/education.tex)
%-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
\cvsection{Education}

\begin{cventries}
\BLOCK{for ed in education}

  \cventry
    {\VAR{ed.degree}} % Degree
    {\VAR{ed.org}} % Institution
    {} % Location
    {\BLOCK{if ed.start}\VAR{ed.start} - \BLOCK{endif}\VAR{ed.end}} % Date(s)
    {}
\BLOCK{endfor}

\end{cventries}

%-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
%	SKILLS (the class's cvskills environment)
%-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
\cvsection{Skills}

\begin{cvskills}
\BLOCK{if skill_groups}
\BLOCK{for g in skill_groups}
  \cvskill{\VAR{g.name}}{\VAR{g.skills|join(', ')}}
\BLOCK{endfor}
\BLOCK{else}
  \cvskill{Skills}{\VAR{skills|join(', ')}}
\BLOCK{endif}
\end{cvskills}

\end{document}
